title: Law 4.4 Probe v2: Standalone 1e-5x / 1e4x Scale Shock & 45-Deg Rotation Recovery
intuition: Standalone Law 4.4 scale-equivariance and shock-recovery probe (retiring v1's broken compound R^512 10%-masked probe): runs a 1e-5x-scaled 4-mode 2D GAN hit by a transient 1e4x scale spike and 45-degree rotation at step 300 with >= 500 recovery steps.
failure_mode: Absolute step floors freeze at 1e-5x data scale, while slow-decaying EMA denominators lock up permanently after the step-300 1e4x transient spike.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence v2 diagnostic probe (1,000 updates, shock_step=300, >=500 post-shock recovery steps).
